summary: BioCardia filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 21, 2026, Nasdaq staff notified the company it had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), after the closing bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for at least 10 consecutive business days. The deficiency arose from an August 19, 2026 letter covering the prior 30-day period. The matter is closed; BCDA continues trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure and possible reverse-split or deficiency risk.
